aws.states.state-machine.crud.title: State machines (create, describe, update, delete, list)

aws.states.execution.lifecycle.title: Executions (start, stop, redrive, list, describe, event history)
limitations: The Amazon States Language interpreter runs for real (Pass/Task/Choice/Wait/Succeed/Fail/Parallel/Map), but Wait states complete instantly instead of sleeping for the configured duration.

aws.states.activity.crud.title: Activities (create, describe, delete, list, task polling, SendTaskSuccess/Failure/Heartbeat)

aws.states.state-machine.logging.title: CloudWatch Logs configuration
limitations: loggingConfiguration is ENFORCED: when a CloudWatch Logs destination is set, a finished execution writes its history events to that log group (level ALL = every event, ERROR = failure events, FATAL = execution-level failure/abort/timeout only; includeExecutionData=false strips payloads). Events are delivered when the execution finishes, not as each state runs, and the log group is created on first write.

aws.states.state-machine.tracing.title: X-Ray active tracing
limitations: The tracingConfiguration.enabled flag round-trips through Create/UpdateStateMachine and DescribeStateMachine exactly as set, but Vyomi never emits X-Ray trace segments for an execution.
